description: Immutable identifier for the reused archived confirmation layer
Locked independent Monte Carlo seed blocks used once for the combined MC and stress confirmation layer
One predeclared family-by-engine hypothesis per row
Both metrics require CI and BH-FDR confirmation in Monte Carlo and stress analyses
Stress reuses seeds 21-26 and is not represented as a second independent held-out panel
Real-world scoring begins only after the candidate manifest produced by this protocol is frozen
